name: Antitrust Crackdown
description: A major antitrust investigation threatens to reshape market structure through forced divestitures

phases.name: Investigation Announced
headlines: Regulators launch sweeping antitrust investigation into dominant {sector} firms
Competition authority subpoenas records from major {sector} companies
{sector} stocks tumble as antitrust probe scope wider than expected
phases.summary: A sweeping antitrust investigation targeting dominant {sector} firms shakes investor confidence in the sector.

phases.name: Charges Filed
headlines: Government files formal antitrust charges against leading {sector} companies
Proposed remedies include forced divestiture of key {sector} business units
{sector} companies face potential billions in fines and structural changes
phases.summary: Formal antitrust charges with proposed structural remedies create severe uncertainty for major {sector} companies.

phases.name: Negotiated Settlement
headlines: {sector} firms reach settlement with regulators avoiding breakup
Consent decree imposes behavioral remedies but preserves {sector} company structures
{sector} stocks rally as worst-case breakup scenario avoided
phases.summary: A negotiated settlement avoids forced breakups in exchange for behavioral remedies and significant fines.

phases.name: Breakup Ordered
headlines: Court orders structural breakup of dominant {sector} companies
Historic antitrust ruling forces divestiture of core {sector} business units
{sector} sector faces years of uncertainty as breakup implementation begins
phases.summary: A landmark court ruling orders structural breakups, creating years of uncertainty and restructuring for the {sector} sector.

phases.name: Competitive Revival
headlines: {sector} sector adapts to new competitive landscape with innovation surge
Settlement compliance costs prove manageable for major {sector} firms
phases.summary: The {sector} sector adapts to the settlement terms and a more competitive landscape drives innovation.

phases.name: Sector Fragmentation
headlines: Spun-off {sector} units struggle as standalone entities
Foreign competitors gain market share as domestic {sector} firms restructure
{sector} sector value destruction continues as breakup costs mount
phases.summary: Forced breakups destroy value as spun-off units struggle independently and foreign competitors gain ground.

name: Tax Reform
description: A major tax reform proposal creates uncertainty about corporate profitability and market valuations

phases.name: Reform Proposed
headlines: Government proposes sweeping corporate tax overhaul with significant rate increases
Markets stumble as tax reform proposal threatens corporate earnings
Analysts estimate tax plan could reduce S&P earnings by 10-15%
phases.summary: A major corporate tax reform proposal threatens to significantly reduce corporate profitability across the market.

phases.name: Legislative Battle
headlines: Tax reform bill advances through committee with key amendments
Corporate lobbying intensifies as tax vote approaches
Markets whipsaw on conflicting signals about tax reform passage
phases.summary: The legislative process creates persistent uncertainty as the tax bill advances with various amendments and compromises.

phases.name: Reform Blocked
headlines: Tax reform bill fails to pass as key legislators defect
Markets surge in relief rally as corporate tax increase averted
Status quo preserved as tax reform effort collapses
phases.summary: The tax reform bill fails to pass, preserving the status quo and triggering a broad relief rally.

phases.name: Reform Passed
headlines: Tax reform bill signed into law with higher corporate rates effective next quarter
Companies scramble to restructure ahead of new tax regime
Market selloff accelerates as higher tax rates become reality
phases.summary: The tax reform passes into law, forcing companies to adapt to higher rates and compressing market-wide earnings.

phases.name: Policy Stability
headlines: Markets settle into new equilibrium with tax uncertainty removed
Investment confidence returns as regulatory outlook clarifies
phases.summary: With tax reform off the table, policy certainty returns and markets settle into a stable growth trajectory.

phases.name: Earnings Compression
headlines: First quarter under new tax regime confirms earnings impact worse than expected
Companies cut dividends and buybacks to offset higher tax burden
Market multiples compress permanently to reflect lower after-tax earnings
phases.summary: The full impact of higher taxes becomes clear with worse-than-expected earnings compression and reduced shareholder returns.

name: Environmental Regulations
description: Sweeping new environmental rules impose significant compliance costs on carbon-intensive industries

phases.name: New Rules Announced
headlines: Government unveils aggressive new emissions regulations for {sector} industry
Carbon pricing mechanism proposed at levels far exceeding expectations
{sector} companies face billions in compliance costs under new environmental rules
phases.summary: Aggressive new environmental regulations with stringent emissions limits and carbon pricing threaten {sector} profitability.

phases.name: Compliance Scramble
headlines: {sector} companies warn compliance costs will significantly reduce margins
Smaller {sector} operators may not survive regulatory transition costs
Industry group files legal challenge against new {sector} environmental rules
phases.summary: The {sector} industry scrambles to assess compliance costs while filing legal challenges against the regulations.

phases.name: Industry Adapts
headlines: {sector} companies find compliance costs lower than initial estimates
Green technology investments by {sector} firms create new revenue streams
First movers in {sector} gain competitive advantage from early compliance
phases.summary: The {sector} industry adapts to regulations more efficiently than feared, with early adopters gaining competitive advantages.

phases.name: Industry Exodus

Legal challenge fails as court upholds environmental rules in full
{sector} jobs and investment flee as compliance costs prove unmanageable
phases.summary: With legal challenges failing, {sector} companies begin relocating operations to avoid crushing compliance costs.

phases.name: Green Transition Success
headlines: {sector} sector emerges stronger and cleaner from regulatory transition
ESG-focused investors increase {sector} allocation on sustainability improvements
phases.summary: Successful adaptation to environmental rules attracts ESG capital and positions the {sector} sector for sustainable growth.

phases.name: Hollowed Out Sector

Imports replace domestic {sector} production as companies exit market
Government faces backlash as {sector} job losses mount in key regions
phases.summary: The {sector} sector is permanently diminished domestically as production shifts offshore and jobs are lost.

name: Crypto Regulation Wave
description: A comprehensive cryptocurrency regulatory framework creates upheaval in digital asset markets and related stocks

phases.name: Framework Proposed
headlines: Government proposes comprehensive cryptocurrency regulatory framework
Exchange registration requirements and stablecoin reserves mandated in new bill
Crypto-exposed stocks tumble as regulatory uncertainty spikes
phases.summary: A comprehensive crypto regulatory framework proposal creates significant uncertainty for digital asset markets and related stocks.

phases.name: Exchange Impact

Stablecoin reserves found inadequate, triggering panic redemptions
Crypto mining operations targeted by new energy consumption regulations
phases.summary: Enforcement actions against exchanges and stablecoin concerns create turmoil across the crypto ecosystem.

phases.name: Regulatory Clarity
headlines: Final crypto regulations provide clear compliance pathway for legitimate operators
Institutional investors increase crypto allocation as regulatory clarity improves
Compliant exchanges gain market share as industry professionalizes
phases.summary: Clear and workable regulations legitimize the crypto industry, attracting institutional capital and professionalizing the market.

phases.name: Effective Ban

Major exchanges announce exit from domestic market amid unworkable rules
Crypto industry moves entirely offshore as domestic access severed
phases.summary: Regulations prove so restrictive they effectively ban most crypto activities domestically, driving the industry offshore.

phases.name: Crypto Mainstream
headlines: Regulated crypto products launch on major traditional exchanges
Banks begin offering crypto custody and trading under new framework
phases.summary: Regulatory clarity enables mainstream adoption with banks and traditional exchanges offering crypto products.

phases.name: Innovation Exodus
headlines: Crypto talent and startups relocate en masse to friendlier jurisdictions
Domestic fintech sector weakened as blockchain innovation moves offshore
Markets price in permanent loss of crypto-related revenue streams
phases.summary: The effective ban drives a permanent exodus of crypto innovation and talent, weakening the broader fintech ecosystem.

phases.name: Compliance Scramble

{sector} firms rush to develop privacy-compliant alternatives to targeted advertising
phases.summary: The {sector} industry scrambles to assess the impact and develop compliant alternatives as the privacy bill advances.

phases.name: Manageable Impact

{sector} companies demonstrate privacy-preserving ad technology meets requirements
Market impact less severe than feared as {sector} adapts business models
phases.summary: The final legislation includes practical provisions that allow {sector} companies to adapt their models without catastrophic impact.

phases.name: Industry Disruption

phases.summary: The strict privacy law fundamentally disrupts {sector} advertising models, causing severe revenue declines.

phases.name: Privacy-First Growth

phases.summary: Privacy-first approaches become a competitive advantage, with compliant {sector} companies gaining user trust and market share.

phases.name: Structural Revenue Loss

Subscription model pivot fails to offset advertising revenue losses for most {sector} firms
Foreign {sector} competitors with looser privacy rules gain global market share
phases.summary: Permanent loss of data monetization capabilities forces a structural repricing of the {sector} sector with lasting revenue declines.
